# BrandCue AI – Intelligent Brand Governance Platform

> **Tagline:** Every Content. One Consistent Brand.

**BrandCue AI** is a complete, modern, enterprise-grade Brand Governance SaaS platform built to help organisations maintain strict brand consistency across content generated by employees, external agencies, freelancers, and AI tools.

The platform analyses submitted content against approved brand guidelines, verified facts, approved terminology, and tone references. It identifies potential violations, explains reasons with supporting evidence, recommends safe corrections, and empowers authorised humans to make final approval decisions.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

### 1. Dual AI & Explainable Governance Engine
- **Google Gemini API Integration**: Real-time analysis with `gemini-1.5-flash`, `gemini-2.0-flash`, or `gemini-1.5-pro`.
- **Deterministic Local Governance Engine**: Built-in, high-performance rule and heuristic engine that scans for prohibited vocabulary, unverified superlatives ("#1 rated", "best in the world"), and factual contradictions without requiring external API keys.
- **Explicit Uncertainty Disclosures**: Follows the mandatory governance principle: missing evidence is never assumed to be false; instead, it is explicitly flagged as `needs_verification` with clear uncertainty disclaimers.

### 2. Multi-Role Enterprise Simulation
- **Administrator** (`Sarah Lin`): Manages brand guideline PDFs, approved facts, terminology matrix (prohibited vs preferred terms), tone and voice rules, approved messaging, and team permissions.
- **Creator** (`Elena Rostova`): Submits content drafts or text-based PDFs, monitors the live 5-stage analysis pipeline, inspects explainable findings, and applies one-click smart corrections.
- **Reviewer** (`Marcus Vance`): Evaluates evidence excerpts, participates in threaded comments, requests changes, and issues binding human approvals. Content is never automatically published without human sign-off.

### 3. High-Performance Text-Based PDF Ingestion
- **PyMuPDF (`pymupdf`) Integration**: Seamlessly parses text-based PDFs for both brand guideline ingestion and content submission, extracting clean text, page counts, character counts, and metadata.

### 4. Interactive Violation Inspector & Smart Corrections
- **Split-Screen Reviewer**: Flagged passages are dynamically highlighted with color-coded severity badges (Critical, High, Medium, Low, Needs Verification). Clicking any highlighted word auto-scrolls to the matching finding card.
- **Smart Correction Assistant**: Presents safe drop-in replacement sentences with clear rationale.
- **Side-by-Side Diff**: Live side-by-side comparison between the original draft and revised versions.

### 5. Human-in-the-Loop Review & Revision Audit History
- Formal reviewer decisions: **Approve**, **Request Changes**, **Reject**.
- Full **Revision History Audit Trail** tracking versions (`v1`, `v2`, `v3`...), timestamps, author attribution, and change summaries.

### 6. Governance Insights & Executive Analytics
- Interactive charts and KPI metrics visualizing review velocity, violation category breakdowns, channel compliance rates, and recurring prohibited terminology infractions.

## 🏗️ Architecture & Technology Stack

```
brandcue-ai/
├── backend/
│   ├── database.py              # SQLite configuration with SQLAlchemy 2.0
│   ├── models.py                # Relational data schema (Users, Workspaces, Guidelines, Findings, Revisions)
│   ├── main.py                  # FastAPI REST endpoints & CORS configuration
│   ├── requirements.txt         # Python dependencies
│   ├── test_e2e.py              # End-to-end automated verification script
│   └── services/
│       ├── ai_service.py        # Gemini AI & Local Governance Engine
│       ├── pdf_service.py       # PyMuPDF PDF text extraction
│       └── seed_data.py         # Realistic enterprise seed data (ApexCloud)
└── frontend/
    ├── package.json             # React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide icons, Recharts
    ├── vite.config.js           # Vite configuration with API proxy
    └── src/
        ├── App.jsx              # Main application shell with navigation
        ├── index.css            # Tailwind styling and design tokens
        ├── context/
        │   └── AppContext.jsx   # State management (Role switching, Workspace, API keys)
        ├── services/
        │   └── api.js           # Frontend API client
        ├── components/layout/
        │   ├── Header.jsx       # Header with AI status & Gemini key modal
        │   └── Sidebar.jsx      # Sidebar with live role switcher
        └── pages/
            ├── DashboardOverview.jsx   # KPIs, Recharts analytics, recent submissions
            ├── BrandKnowledgeBase.jsx  # Guidelines, Facts, Terminology matrix, PDF upload
            ├── ContentAnalyzer.jsx     # Content submission & live 5-stage pipeline
            ├── ReviewFindings.jsx      # Highlighted text viewer & smart corrections
            ├── ApprovalWorkflow.jsx    # Reviewer decision panel & revision audit
            ├── GovernanceInsights.jsx  # Trends, channel matrix, top infractions
            ├── TeamManagement.jsx      # Member permissions and role matrix
            └── Settings.jsx            # Workspace & AI engine configuration
```

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.10+
- Node.js 18+ and npm

### 1. Backend Setup
```bash
cd backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
```
The backend initializes the SQLite database and seeds it automatically with enterprise brand data on startup.
- API Documentation: [http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs](http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs)

### 2. Frontend Setup
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```
The frontend starts at [http://127.0.0.1:5173](http://127.0.0.1:5173).

---

## 🧪 Testing

Run the automated end-to-end test suite:
```bash
cd backend
python test_e2e.py
```
